sources.title: Josephus, Antiquities 18.1–4, 26
sources.note: William Whiston translation. The assessment follows Archelaus's removal; 18.26 relates its completion to the 37th year from Actium. AD 6 is a regnal-year reconstruction, not a BC/AD label printed by Josephus. Bracketed AD 7/AD 8 labels in this edition are later editorial annotations and are not used as independent dating evidence.

sources.title: Josephus, Antiquities 17
sources.note: William Whiston translation. Eclipse and regnal totals enter competing modern datings; preserve the reasoning between text and date.

sources.title: Jeffrey R. Chadwick, Dating the Birth of Christ
sources.note: A particular scholarly argument, with religious commitments, not a statement of universal scholarly agreement. Used for the 4 BC Herod framework and census difficulty, not adoption of every conclusion.

sources.title: Andrew E. Steinmann, When Did Herod the Great Reign? (2009)
sources.locator: Novum Testamentum 51, 1–29; conclusion and regnal argument
sources.note: Minority 1 BC death reconstruction. The article is accessible; no full adjudication of its regnal chronology is claimed.

sources.title: Ernest L. Martin, The Star That Astonished the World, chapter 5
sources.note: Source of the 11 September 3 BC proposal and Revelation 12 interpretation. Claims of Tishri 1 and the 90-minute interval are claims under assessment, not verified inputs.

sources.title: Michael R. Molnar, The Coin of Antioch (1995)
sources.note: PDF reopened but body did not extract in this pass. March interpretation is carried from the linked birthday audit; a fresh full-text check remains outstanding.

sources.title: Michael R. Molnar, The Star of Bethlehem (2001 lecture abstract)
sources.note: Author's abstract hosted by NASA; neither full lecture inspection nor NASA endorsement.

sources.title: Chronography of 354, Depositio martyrum
sources.locator: Opening December 25 entry; MGH Chronica Minora I, 71–72
sources.note: Fourth-century commemoration evidence. No inference of a first-century birth certificate; the earlier AD 336 dating of the list is not needed for this packet.

sources.title: Library of Congress / IAA, A Calendrical Document, 4Q321
sources.note: 364-day calendar and priestly roster context. Does not establish the Jerusalem Temple's schedule in Zechariah's year.

sources.title: OpenBible.info, Bethlehem location record

coverageRules: Directly checked means the specified passage or section was read, not every argument in the publication.
Carried evidence remains attributed to the earlier review; no fresh inspection is implied.
Source existence, source accuracy and truth of the proposition are separate checks.
Only brief WEB quotations and original paraphrases are embedded; no third-party images are bundled.
